messages.author: 3dcc4706e808d5df
messages.subject: Group data by color
parts:
Hi,

I would like to group my graph based on different breed of dogs and color each breed differently, is there any way I could do it?

The data I have is in csv format, and there's a column of dog breeds.

Thanks!

messages.author: 3376a14ec4e06f88
messages.subject: Re: Group data by color
parts:
Hi, if for example you want to colour the tips by the dog breed, you can add the below:

tree <- tree + geom_tiplab(aes(colour = NAME_OF_COLUMN_OF_DOG_BREEDS))

where tree is the tree (generated from ggtree())

If this is not what you are after, please reply.
